notes.title: Happy Mining Update
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

A while ago we published an announcement about future extensions to Happy Mining, which we have since removed.
From the four planned phases, we have reduced the size to one update. The reason for this decision is the problematic programming
of new content. Originally, Happy Mining was a kind of clicker game in a 3D world. 
We have gradually expanded this and have problems with the programming of the basis, which is designed for a clicker game. This can be seen in the inventory system. 
Normally you can move items in the inventory, use or equip items and move items in trade. As our foundation is a "clicker" game, we have also transferred the system of increasing numbers to the inventory.

This is just one example of many that we always have to navigate around. However, when creating further content, we realized that we could no longer continue to do this to the same extent. We need to bring our ideas into a new game. In the future, we want to create a role-playing game with the visual style of Happy Mining,
whose concept remains the same from start to finish and we don't change the genre during development. 
Therefore, patch 1.1.0.0 is the final game in content terms.
If bugs or other errors are found, we will of course fix them. This will happen faster than in the last few months. Because we have adapted the game so much,
we could no longer reproduce the old version and have included all reported bugs in this patch. In the future there will only be fixes.

After this project, we will switch to a completely different genre, which we will announce at the beginning of next year. We would like to thank you for your interest in the game and would be pleased 
if you follow our other projects.

notes.title: Happy Mining reaches Version 1.0
notes.notes:
What is new?

- The game world has been rebuilt and is now more compact as well as more lively
- A world map has been added to the game and can be bought from the mage
- Mage has now arrived in her house
- Three new legendary weapons can be found in the world
- New HUD/GUI system
- Mining quantities are now displayed when farming
- AI / NPC has been enhanced to bring more life into the game
- Golem pit has been added (entrance in the mine)
- Golem Boss (NPC) can be found in the golem pit and drops items
- WSAD customization and invented controls have been added
- Invert mouse settings added to game menu
- Dragons now fly over Dragon Spring and drop dragon shards (dragon scales can be picked
   up here)
- The home is expanded with an armory for the Legendary Weapons
- In the tavern the innkeeper now offers new tasks
- Access to the farm as well as unlocking the cooking pot for potions must now be purchased
- Particle effects when mining resources have been added
- Some NPCs now have optional info dialogs
- New bridge builder NPC is now findable. Will only become relevant with a future DLC

notes.title: Happy Mining Hotfix 0.8.0.2:
notes.notes:
New:

- New category for game menu : Gameplay
  Character growth can be disabled

Fixes and adjustment: 

- Texts have been changed and extended 
- Soundfixes (effect sounds) 
- HUD adjustments (inventory / crafting window) 
- Steel production now works properly and has the right icons
- Fine forge now works properly
- The stone press now shows the correct amount of sand
- The quantities of the signs for the buildings now have the correct values
- Workers for geodes are now assigned correctly
- Nothing with a quantity of 0 can be sold in the marketplace
- Petbuff mining quantity now adds 50%
- Animal seller has furniture in the house again
- Wood oven is invisible again before buying

notes.title: Happy Mining Hotfix 0.8.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixes and adjustment: 

- Texts have been changed and extended 
- Skills purchased from traders are now saved after restarting the game
- Soundfixes (effect sounds) 
- Skill book is now usable from the beginning
- HUD adjustments (inventory / crafting window) 
- You can now run up stairs in the castle without having to jump.
- Adjustments to the landscape
- Steel production now works properly
- The jump strength is now loaded from the savegame
- All skills are now saved even after restarting the game
- Mining quantities of all resources (stone, wood, iron, silver, gold, geodes) have been increased
- Achievements should work now (may be displayed delayed)
- Market store fixed (purchase request timer bug)
- Price for iron ingots was corrected to 10
- Hit bug fixed

Note: If you had problems with unsaved skills, after the patch the skill will work correctly from now on. If you have skilled too often, we recommend a new savegame, because the savegame will not be adjusted with the patch. We ask for your understanding.
